resource_additions.name: Research Through Design (RTD): Conference Series and Proceedings
resource_additions.description: Practice-based design research conference series with curated artifact exhibitions, facilitated roundtable discussions and publicly linked proceedings from its 2013-2019 editions. Returns in 2027 as university-hosted RTD Roams, welcoming researchers, independent practitioners and work in progress. The archive is separate from dated submission calls and conference meetings.

resource_additions.audit_note: Official conference-series archive, November 4 announcement and 2027 call inspected November 5, 2026. Series paused after 2019 and now has confirmed 2027 activity. Older simultaneity wording is inconsistent with the distinct July dates; use the dated call. Public links do not establish a blanket reuse license; check rights per proceeding. The current call promises DOI publication for accepted abstracts with attendance, not automatic journal acceptance. No third-party text or images reproduced.

event_additions.name: RTD Roams 2027: Extended Abstract Submission Deadline
event_additions.description: Shared submission deadline for RTD Roams in Melbourne, York and Tokyo. Submit an anonymized abstract of up to 1,000 words excluding references and captions, plus 6-8 images at 300 dpi. Open to independent practitioners, researchers and students. One double-blind review round; work must include a research artifact or material trace. No submission fee; accepted authors must attend their selected site in person and pay registration. Submission template and final instructions remain forthcoming; no cutoff time or time zone is specified.
event_additions.source: Official RTD Roams call and organizer announcement dated November 4, 2026; verified November 5, 2026. https://researchthroughdesign.org/rtd-roams-2027-full-call-for-contributions-launched/

event_additions.name: RTD Roams 2027: Naarm / Melbourne
event_additions.description: Research Through Design gathering hosted by RMIT and Monash University on situated knowledge, materiality and relationality. Curated research artifacts and work in progress support roundtable discussions. In-person participation; no hybrid attendance. Shared abstract deadline February 1, 2027; organizer-listed standard registration AUD 350, with final fee details and concessions to follow. Accepted abstracts receive DOIs through Figshare subject to author attendance.
